title: Fidelity Synopses: Pre-Execution Plan Selection for Approximate Vector Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.41407v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vector search has become a database operator with many physical implementations: different index families, build-time and search-time parameters, and compressed or disk-resident variants. Each trades cost against fidelity, the fraction of a query's exact top-k nearest neighbors that a configuration returns. Deployments nevertheless choose one configuration offline and use it for every query, so they are sized for their hardest queries and overpay for the rest. On a 5.8M-item LAION benchmark with four embedding models, running each query on the cheapest configuration that suffices for it would roughly halve the cost in a typical setting. Exploiting this requires predicting each configuration's fidelity before running it, which is hard because fidelity is defined by the very exact search that approximate indexes avoid. translated_title: 忠实度摘要：近似向量搜索的执行前计划选择
translated_abstract: 向量搜索已成为一种具有多种物理实现的数据库算子：不同的索引族、构建时与搜索时参数，以及压缩或磁盘驻留的变体。每种实现都在成本与忠实度之间进行权衡，忠实度指某个配置返回的查询精确top-k最近邻的比例。然而现有部署通常离线选定一种配置并用于所有查询，因此它们按最难处理的查询来配置规模，而对其他查询支付了过高的成本。在一个包含580万条目的LAION基准测试中（使用四种嵌入模型），若让每个查询都运行在满足其需求的最低成本配置上，在典型设置下可将成本大致减半。要利用这一点，需要在运行前预测每个配置的忠实度，这十分困难，因为忠实度恰恰是由近似索引试图避免的精确搜索所定义的。关系型优化器通过离线摘要解决了基数估计的类似问题；我们为向量搜索提出了对应的方案。
tldr: 该论文提出“忠实度摘要”方法，借鉴关系型数据库的离线摘要思想，在执行前预测各近似向量搜索配置的忠实度，从而为每个查询动态选择满足其需求的最低成本配置，在典型场景下可将近似搜索成本减半。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Fidelity Synopses, an offline-synopsis-based approach that predicts the fidelity of approximate vector search configurations before execution, enabling per-query selection of the cheapest sufficient configuration and roughly halving search costs in typical settings.
